release_name: Deep reconciliation — parser rebuilt, 2 further corrections
notes: Deep re-check. The parser was rebuilt to actually understand the diocese pages: 'Pas de messes' is now read as positive evidence of absence; OFFICES/LAUDES sub-sections are non-Mass; prose schedules are parsed; 'sauf jeudi' excludes rather than includes; time ranges are one event; off-site Masses are attributed to the church named; and duplicate listings across a parish page and a chapel page are de-duplicated. 10 time corrections in total across v27.4.3-27.4.5. Zero unambiguous differences remain. 3 sites where two official pages contradict each other are flagged, not silently changed.
